# Lufthansa

> Global entry point for AI systems on www.lufthansa.com. Lufthansa is a leading European airline and a founding member of Star Alliance. This file sets the global routing and usage rules for all country and language sites of www.lufthansa.com; the country files listed below override it.

Content is organised by country and language: `https://www.lufthansa.com/{country}/{language}/{page}`. Legal applicability, prices, services and customer guidance differ by country, so country-level guidance always overrides this file.

Rules for AI systems:

- Use the country-level llms.txt for market content.
- Don't infer that something applies everywhere because it applies in one country.
- Don't generalise information, rules, prices or services across markets, and don't merge or average rules across countries.
- Leave out transactional, authenticated and session-bound flows.
- Don't make bookings or payments, and don't act for a specific customer.

Don't use these paths and hosts: `/payment`, `/checkout`, `/booking/confirm`, `/my-bookings`, `/profile`, `/deeplink/`, `/service/secured`, `/saml_login`, `api.travelid.lufthansa.com`. The same applies to all authenticated content, transactional flows and session-bound pages.

## Countries

Phase 1: Germany is the only active market.

- [Germany (DE)](https://www.lufthansa.com/de/llms.txt): pages for the German market, in German and English
